name: Shufersal
description: Israel's largest supermarket chain (est. 1958) with ~300+ stores, private labels and the Be drugstore chain; one of the country's biggest retail advertisers.

relations.note: agency via Brickman (Adler Chomski group) from Dec 2025 (ICE)

notes: Jun 2024: Shufersal cut agencies and parted from Gitam BBDO after ~30 years; Glickman-Shamir-Samsonov (took a portion from Adler Chomski in 2022) is credited for Shufersal in Globes' 2025 review. Dec 2025: under the Amir brothers' control, Shufersal moved its ad budget to Brickman of the Adler Chomski group (ICE), replacing Glickman-Shamir-Samsonov. Agency as of 2025-12.
description_he: רשת הסופרמרקטים הגדולה בישראל (נוסדה ב-1958) עם כ-300+ סניפים, מותגים פרטיים ורשת הפארם Be; מהמפרסמים הגדולים בקמעונאות בארץ.
